about: Development measurement (local headless Chromium 153, cloud VM, wllama 3.8.1, the pinned GGUF, n_gpu_layers 0, 1 thread, n_ctx 4096 in this scratch harness): one 41-token prompt (system 'Write JSON only.' and a short user message), no prompt cache, temperature 0. Three request variants to separate the cost of the grammar and of the token probabilities from the cost of a long context.

runs.variant: json_schema grammar (49,387-character GBNF, not lazy) + logprobs (pre-sampling, n_probs 1)

compare: With the reader's 1,805-token fixed prompt in context (standalone-check.json) generation took 1,098-1,251 ms per token: the long context, not the grammar or the probabilities, is what makes generation slow here.
